HEADER: Init +5; Senses darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision; Perception +23
Aura Dark Aqua Dome (40-ft., shadow and water resistance reduction for 1d4 rounds, Will DC 27 negates)
DEFENSE: AC 25, touch 20, flat-footed 20 (+4 deflect, +5 dex, +1 dodge, +5 natural)
Immune critical hits, death effects, poison, sneak attacks, shadow, water;
OFFENSE: Melee Slam +12 (1d6 plus 1d8 [half shadow/water damage]) or Touch +12 (1d3 Wis damage)
At will (DC 15) - bleed, detect magic, mending, message, read magic
3rd (DC 18) - dark III, darkra, sleepga (DC 17), water III, watera
5th (DC 20) - darkga, drain, drown, gloom, sleepja (DC 19), waterga
STATISTICS: Str 10, Dex 20, Con 15, Int 20, Wis 15, Cha 18

Feats Alertness, Combat Casting, Dodge, Elemental Focus (shadow, water), Empower Spell, Extend Spell, Extra MP, Greater Spell Penetration, Silent Spell, Spell Penetration, Spell Specialization (Shadow, Water)
Skills Acrobatics +24, Bluff +24, Escape Artist +24, Knowledge (arcana) +24, Knowledge (local) +24, Knowledge (nature) +24, Perception +22, Sense Motive +22, Spellcraft +24, Stealth +24
Languages Aquan, Slyvan, Undercommon + 2 others (DM's choice)
SPECIAL ABILITIES: Congeal Water (su) Once every 1d2 rounds as a standard action, The yakshi can surround a creature in a thin layer of magically viscous water. A target that fails the Reflex save (DC 27) becomes entangled and must hold its breath or risk drowning. The target or an adjacent creature can spend a full-round action on its turn scraping off the clinging fluid, allowing a new Reflex save with a +2 bonus; otherwise, the effect lasts for 1d4 minutes. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 1st level spell (Knowledge: Nature DC 17).

Dark Aqua Dome (su) All creatures within a 40-foot radius from yakshi must make a DC 27 Will save or have their water and shadow resistance dropped by 10 for 1d4 rounds. Whether or not the save is successful, that creature cannot be affected again by the same yakshi's dark aqua dome ability for 24 hours. The save DC is Charisma-based.

Liquid Form (su) A yakshi is always in liquid form. She gains immunity to critical hits, poison, and sneak attacks. She also has DR/15 magic. She retains her own base speed, and her swim speed doubles to 120 feet.

Malediction (su) 1/day, a yakshi can release malevolence from within draining the health of all nearby enemies within a 30-ft.-radius spread. A yakshi deals 12d6 points of shadow damage and is healed by half of the total damage done unless those in the area must make a Fortitude save (DC 27) to negate the heal affect and take half damage. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 9th level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 33).

Mesmerizing Voice (su) Once every 1d3+1 rounds as a standard action, Yakshi sings a mesmerizing song that charms all those nearby her. Creatures within 30 feet of yakshi must make a Will save (DC 27) or be charmed for 1 minute. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 4th level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 23).
Unearthly Grace (su) A yakshi adds her Charisma modifier as a racial bonus on all her saving throws and as a deflection bonus to her AC.

parsed.description: A spirit which has taken the shape of a beautiful woman. The yakshi follows the orders of its master whom it formed a blood pact with, and guards locations of great importance. They are famous for how they change in strength depending on its master's primary emotion. In particular, yakshis that form pacts with those who holds a grudge or bears deep hatred often exhibit powers greater than other yakshis, but because they all look alike, it is hard to tell how strong they are, so facing them without proper preparation is an unwise decision to make.

rulesDecisions: Actor data preserves the source statblock in biography and builder flags before any Foundry runtime hydration.
Only true feats, spells, and inventory placeholders are eligible for compendium lookup during import; creature-specific special abilities remain custom generated features.
Racial hit dice are generated from the creature type and source hit dice instead of creating class levels.
Source defensive text is mapped into FFD20 trait fields while unusual FF defenses remain preserved as custom text.
Natural attack items use source attack totals, source damage dice, and manual extra attacks for full-attack routines.
Spell and spell-like ability lines create spell placeholders that should hydrate from installed FFD20/PF spell compendiums.
Skill ranks are reverse-calculated from source totals after ability modifiers, racial modifiers, size modifiers, and class-skill bonuses.
